score_confidence_rationale: High confidence that 0.0 is the CORRECT formulaic output given zero (metric,dataset,split) matches -- not high confidence that the implementation is bad. See benchmark_comparison.md.

algorithmic_fidelity_checks.note: Qualitative code-level checks that the paper's own equations/mechanisms behave as specified (see benchmark_comparison.md); these do NOT factor into reproducibility_score, which is strictly the metric-matching formula.

manual_review_reason: Score is a direct consequence of dataset/pretrained-model unavailability (see benchmark_comparison.md), not a signal to distrust the code. A human should re-run this comparison once real NEO-Dataset + Stable Diffusion + CLIP/DINO access is available before drawing conclusions about implementation correctness.
